facts.fact: UNESCO says it, the Government of Cameroon and the World Bank officially launched the Integrated Sectoral Platform for the Education Management Information System (EMIS).

facts.fact: PAREC says the ministry of basic education held an official ceremony on 8 May 2025 presenting the integrated sectoral SIGE platform (sige-sectoriel.cm), designed to centralise statistics of all education and training subsectors and hosted by the National Institute of Statistics.
facts.system: plateforme sectorielle intégrée du Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)

systems.owner: Institut National de la Statistique (host); Ministère de l'Éducation de Base

facts.fact: The National Institute of Statistics says more specific education data than its 2021-2022 sectoral yearbook can be accessed via the online EMIS industry platform.

PAREC, under UNESCO and a September 2022 agreement with the Government of Cameroon, handed the National Institute of Statistics a server, laptops, desktops and a SQL-server licence on 4 June 2024 to operationalize the integrated sectoral education management information system platform, with a dedicated EMIS internet line still to be provided.

note: SchoolMap is described as a tuition and exam fee payment platform; it is not said to be an education information system holding learner records.
Matricule Unique is introduced as a pupil identifier tied to fee payment; the article does not say a ministry education information system holds learner records or that the identifier is in service.
